description.zh: 根据已有文本的内容和风格，自然流畅地续写后续内容，保持逻辑和文风的一致性
description.en: Naturally continue the text based on its content and style, keeping logic and voice consistent

promptTemplate.zh:
请续写以下文本，保持内容、风格和逻辑的一致性：

{{text}}

要求：
1. 自然流畅地延续原文的内容和风格
2. 保持逻辑连贯性
3. 只输出续写的内容，不要重复原文
promptTemplate.en:
Please continue the following text, keeping its content, style, and logic consistent:

{{text}}

Requirements:
1. Continue naturally and fluently, matching the original content and style
2. Maintain logical coherence
3. Output only the continuation, do not repeat the original text

systemPrompt.zh: 你是一个专业的文本续写助手，擅长根据已有内容自然流畅地延续写作。
systemPrompt.en: You are a professional writing assistant skilled at naturally continuing existing text.

input.text: 每天坚持阅读三十分钟，看似微不足道，但日积月累的力量不容小觑。

zh.output: 一年下来，你将读完数十本书，知识储备和思维深度都会有质的飞跃。更重要的是，这种习惯会潜移默化地改变你的思考方式，让你在面对问题时更加从容和理性。从今天开始，不妨为自己设定一个小目标，在固定的时间里，放下手机，拿起一本书，享受阅读带来的宁静与成长。

input.text: Reading for thirty minutes every day may seem insignificant, but the power of accumulation over time should not be underestimated.

en.output: Over the course of a year, you will finish dozens of books, and both your knowledge and depth of thinking will reach a new level. More importantly, this habit will subtly change the way you think, making you calmer and more rational when facing problems. Starting today, why not set a small goal for yourself: at a fixed time, put down your phone, pick up a book, and enjoy the tranquility and growth that reading brings.
